ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels comprise approximately 70-75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the perimeter and central fluke intersection.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the leading and trailing edges. Distinct black diagonal marking on the left lobe (mid-section) and an intersecting 'X' shaped black marking on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex and high depth-to-width ratio at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with visible peaks (amplitudes ranging 5-15 pixels) along the trailing boundary, particularly pronounced on the inner halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep along the trailing edge, transitioning to convex curvature at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, heterogeneous clusters of barnacle colonies localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark linear disruption on the left lobe; two intersecting dark linear marks on the right lobe mid-field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle encrustation on the terminal tips of the fluke, creating a jagged, non-biological texture distinct from the pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Scattered low-density black speckling (micro-mottling) distributed across the central white high-intensity regions of both lobes.
